api.describe.description: 读取当前二进制版本、方法、参数 Schema 与限制。首次调用此方法，不猜测参数或 ID。

config.get.description: 只读完整分组/项目/启动项配置；不要直接覆盖 catalog。大工作空间优先按项目查询。

groups.list.description: 只读分组列表。默认组 id=1；名称不是唯一对象身份。

projects.list.description: 只读登记项目列表，包含 scripts；用路径与 id 确认目标，不按同名误选。

runs.list.description: 只读当前服务运行记录，含 active/state/console_id/superseded；历史不等于仍在运行。

runs.stop_all.description: 请求停止全部受管/已核实活动实例，不限打开标签；区别于只针对打开标签的 bulk_plan。继续查询完成状态。

groups.create.description: 创建分组，返回后端分配的对象与 id；不创建项目或启动任何脚本。

groups.update.description: 按分组 id 修改名称；不修改项目目录或触发重启。

groups.delete.description: 删除分组及其项目、启动项登记；默认组不可删除。只关闭该分组关联的实例：优雅停止超时后强制关闭，确认退出才删除登记。失败保留登记，不删除项目源文件。

projects.get.description: 按项目 id 读取项目元数据和启动项。

projects.delete.description: 移除指定项目及其启动项登记；保留分组、项目目录及源脚本。自动优雅关闭该项目关联实例，超时后强制关闭；确认退出后才移除登记，失败保留登记。API 无文字确认。

projects.refresh.description: 重新读取项目自己的启动来源并校验，保留展示覆盖；不运行脚本，不读取 IDE 配置。

scripts.get.description: 按启动项 id 读取当前配置；不要把整个返回对象直接当作 create spec。

scripts.delete.description: 从项目启动清单删除入口，不删除原脚本；目标活跃时拒绝，先停止并确认 active=false。

runs.get.description: 按精确运行实例 id 查询状态、PID、实际端口和时长。running 仅证明进程创建，不证明业务就绪。

runs.stop.description: 按运行实例 id 请求停止；先 TERM，超时 KILL。异步返回后查询 active=false 才算结束，已结束请求幂等。

projects.create.description: 登记真实项目目录并只读发现其自身启动项；省略/null group 使用 1，不自动启动。

projects.update.description: 只更新 patch 中的 name/description/group/favorite；允许运行中修改，不改变路径、命令或 PID。

scripts.list.description: 只读全部或指定 project_id 的启动项。使用返回的启动项 id 调用启停，不猜测 ID。

entry.description: Externally tagged File/Package/Command/Java/Flutter variant; see api.md

scripts.create.description: 向指定项目新增明确启动项，持久化到 DevStart 数据目录 projects/<project_id>/.dev-start.json；业务项目目录不写入配置，需真实来源文件，只配置不执行。

entry.description: Externally tagged File/Package/Command/Java/Flutter variant; see api.md

display_name.description: Catalog-local display alias, 1–50 Unicode graphemes; null resets. Alias-only patches are allowed while running; execution identity is unchanged.

scripts.update.description: 原子更新指定字段。纯 display_name/description 可运行中修改且不改源清单/argv/PID；其它字段须先停止目标，并校验持久化项目清单。

runs.start.description: 显式执行启动项，返回新 run_id/console_id；异步预检与启停需继续查询状态和日志，返回不代表已就绪。

id.description: 可选：选定重启的原运行记录，保留其Console位置。

runs.restart.description: 原 console_id 内优雅停止、超时强制、确认退出后重启；返回新 run_id。可用 id 指定原实例；后续跟踪新 ID。

logs.read.description: 按累计字节游标分页读取仍保留的日志；每文件10000行/10MiB，全局200MiB/50份/7天。保留范围[base_offset,size)，retained_bytes为当前输出大小。旧游标失效返回reset=true并从base_offset继续；使用next_offset续读，不按文件大小推算。offset/tail_bytes互斥，bytes无损、text便于阅读。

logs.list.description: 分页列出仍保留的日志文件索引，按next_after_id续查；size为磁盘物理字节数。历史按200MiB/50份/7天回收，日志存在不表示实例仍可启停。

api.docs.description: 读取内置完整 Markdown API 手册；不依赖调用者工作目录。

settings.get.description: 读取持久化外观设置，不改变配置。

settings.reset.description: 恢复并保存默认外观设置。

commit_agent.description: discover: first success becomes explicit tool; auto: detect each time; explicit providers never silently fall back

settings.update.description: 验证并原子保存 patch 中的外观字段，实时应用 GUI；未知字段或非法值拒绝。

logs.search.description: 只查询当前有界 Console 缓存；字面关键词、分页行结果和 UTF-8 字节高亮，不扫描完整磁盘日志。

scripts.ports.description: 只读配置/静态推导与实际监听端口及来源；不执行配置文件，不把配置值当作实际观测。

editor.list.description: 列出已注册来源的打开文件与最近历史；不接受任意文件路径。

editor.open.description: 按 script_id 打开或切换原文件缓冲区，返回 content/revision；不执行脚本。

editor.read.description: 读取已打开的草稿与当前 revision；修改前使用此 revision 防止覆盖并发编辑。

content.description: UTF-8 source, at most 1 MiB; no NUL

editor.change.description: 以 expected_revision 校验并更新完整内存草稿；不写磁盘，返回的新 revision 用于后续保存。

editor.save.description: 校验草稿 revision 和磁盘冲突后原子保存，保留权限与最近十版本；冲突不覆盖磁盘。

discard.description: Explicitly discard an unsaved buffer; defaults to false

editor.reload.description: 校验 revision 后重新载入磁盘；有未保存草稿时须明确 discard=true，不能自动丢弃用户修改。

discard.description: Explicitly discard an unsaved buffer; defaults to false

editor.close.description: 校验 revision 并关闭到历史；dirty 时默认拒绝，须先保存或获得明确丢弃意图。

editor.versions.description: 读取最近十个备份版本元数据；版本 id 为十进制字符串，恢复时原样传递。

version_id.description: Decimal version ID returned as a JSON string to preserve 64-bit precision in JavaScript; exact integers also accepted.

editor.restore.description: 使用最新 expected_revision 和 version_id 回退并直接写回源文件；不自动运行，下一次启动使用回退版本。

runs.close.description: 关闭结束标签；活动标签必须显式 stop=true，优雅/强制停止后关闭。不删除原始日志。

runs.open.description: 重新打开仍保留的历史标签，不启动进程；停止并关闭未完成时拒绝。

logs.open_target.description: 使用运行目录解析链接/文件并打开外部程序；只有用户明确要求打开时调用，查看日志无需此操作。

runs.bulk_plan.description: 只读计划：stop 选打开的活动标签，start 选打开的未运行标签，restart 选打开且运行中标签；检查 targets/blocked。

runs.bulk_apply.description: 获得确认后原样提交计划；未确认、过期或被阻止时拒绝。结果含 run_ids/errors，仍需跟踪异步结果，不保证批量事务。

scripts.status.description: 只读简化状态列 {id,label}：确认具体入口运行中为运行中，其它为 --；不能代替 runs.get 完整状态。

git.list.description: List all registered projects and repository state; per-project errors are returned in error.

git.branches.description: List existing local branches. No network request.

git.history.description: Read commits reachable from HEAD, newest first. Version is the commit hash.

git.switch.description: Switch to an existing local branch. Refuses dirty worktrees; no force, stash, or fetch. This changes files in the entire repository, including other registered projects sharing it. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job with id=job_id for terminal status. Do not retry before reading actual result.

git.changes.description: List changed files with raw XY status, path and optional previous rename path. Paths are repository-root relative.

git.diff.description: Read HEAD-to-worktree diff, or untracked text preview (256 KiB). No external diff or textconv.

git.commit.description: Stage and commit only the selected changed paths. Failed commit may leave them staged. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job with id=job_id for terminal status. Do not retry before reading actual result.

git.push.description: Push current branch using configured upstream. No force. Requires explicit authorization to publish commits. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job with id=job_id for terminal status. Do not retry before reading actual result.

git.pull.description: Update the current branch from its preferred configured remote with the saved Merge/Rebase preference; preserve local edits and pause on conflicts. Returns job_id.

git.restore.description: Restore tracked file worktree and index to HEAD after saving binary patches in application storage (last ten backups). Destructive; obtain user authorization. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job with id=job_id for terminal status. Do not retry before reading actual result.

git.command.description: Run a noninteractive Git command with quoting, without shell expansion. Command may mutate local or remote Git state; caller must obtain authorization. Requires git prefix. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job with id=job_id for terminal status. Do not retry before reading actual result.

git.job.description: Poll an asynchronous Git job. Returns id/state/output/error; state is running, succeeded or failed. Last 16 jobs retained in memory; at most four running.

terminal.open.description: Open or reuse a project PTY shell, initially in the actual project directory, not the repository root. At most eight live sessions.

terminal.read.description: Read bounded terminal transcript, prompt, active/busy/echo, generation, exit_code and non-secret history. Poll for live output.

terminal.line.description: Send one line plus Enter to the shell or foreground program. May execute arbitrary shell commands or publish data; requires corresponding authorization. Password input is excluded from history when terminal echo is off.

terminal.interrupt.description: Send terminal Ctrl+C to interrupt the foreground command.

terminal.clear.description: Clear in-memory display; does not reset shell state or working directory.

terminal.close.description: Close a project terminal; terminate its process group gracefully then force after two seconds.

git.remotes.description: List all configured fetch addresses as stable key/name/url/preferred targets. URL credentials and query strings are redacted. No network call or Git configuration mutation.

git.update.description: Fetch then Merge/Rebase without committing local edits or pushing. Local edits are restored through an owned stash; conflicts require review. Optional method defaults to the repository preference.

git.push_target.description: Push HEAD to the selected remote address current branch without force; requires publish authorization. Returns {job_id,state:running}; poll git.job for completion. Select remote_key from git.remotes; do not guess it.

git.commit_files.description: Read immutable commit metadata, parents, comparison base and changed files. Merge commits compare to the first parent; initial commits compare to the empty tree.

git.commit_diff.description: Read the selected commit file unified diff against the same comparison base. File must belong to this commit; renames include both paths. Binary changes are reported by Git. No checkout, external diff or textconv.

scan.start.description: 只读后台扫描目录；不执行项目代码，不写入项目目录。返回 job_id；同一时刻最多一个扫描，最多保留四个结果。

scan.get.description: 读取扫描状态与完成结果。状态 running/completed/failed/cancelled；结果含 projects、launches、port、existing、warnings、truncated。

scan.cancel.description: 请求取消后台扫描；已完成结果保持可读。

scan.import.description: 仅添加指定扫描结果的 launch_ids，不执行启动。全部验证后原子保存于 DevStart 数据目录；重复启动项忽略，保留已有项目配置。

git.merge.description: 将已有本地 source 分支合并到 target，先安全切换到 target；要求干净工作区，无强制或远程推送。冲突保留现场。返回 job_id，通过 git.job 查询。API 无二次确认，调用方负责授权。

git.restore_version.description: 恢复历史文件树并创建新的本地提交；不修改远程、不重写历史。要求干净工作区、当前分支和 expected_head 未变；保留原 HEAD 备份引用。返回 job_id。API 调用方须取得授权。

groups.refresh.description: 重新发现分组中已登记项目的当前名称、启动项与端口，完整扫描成功后原子更新。保留匹配启动源的 ID、收藏与显示备注；源目录无法读取或配置并发修改时整批失败。不会修改项目源文件。

git.rebase.description: Rebase current local branch onto an existing local branch. Rewrites local commit hashes; no force push. Returns job_id.

git.continue.description: Continue the resolved Merge/Rebase or finish local restoration. Returns job_id.

git.abort.description: Abort active Merge/Rebase and restore the saved local edits. Returns job_id.

git.conflict.description: Read base/current/incoming and working result with an optimistic version token. Binary/large blobs may omit text.

git.resolve.description: Resolve only the exact reviewed version of a conflict; save backup and stage. Edited requires text. Returns job_id.

git.rebase_skip.description: Explicitly skip the currently replayed rebase commit (discarding it), then continue and restore saved local work. Requires user authorization; returns job_id.

git.recovery_finish.description: Acknowledge manual recovery is complete; keep the original stash backup and clear only the DevStart recovery state. Requires user acknowledgment. Returns job_id.

logs.clear.description: 清空指定运行实例的当前 Console 内存视图，不停止服务、不删除磁盘日志；logs.read 的历史内容和字节游标不受影响。

scripts.preset.description: 从已有启动项复制配置，替换名称、参数及端口；不自动运行，保留原入口的执行启用状态。args 是完整 argv 数组，省略端口清空端口。

scripts.describe.description: 根据源文件注释及已有运行证据生成并保存启动项简介，不运行脚本，不调用外部 AI。
